title: Man Sitting on Porch Steps, 1948 Black & White Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot taken on May 9, 1948, capturing a man dressed in working-class attire sitting resting on white wooden porch steps outside a home. A porch with brick walls and a rug draped over the railing is visible behind him. The image reflects post-WWII American everyday suburban or rural domestic life.
